warnings: Elevation 2, looking at the letter-axis face. The grid bubbles run D C B A left to right, so this face is the MIRROR of elevation 4 (A-11) and the two must not be confused.
Same vertical set-out as A-08: +0.00 / +0.40 / +3.40 / +6.65 with the 0.40 / 3.00 / 3.25 chain.

NEW MATERIAL CALLOUT NOT ON A-08: 'ปิดด้วยแผ่นไฟเบอร์ซีเมนต์บอร์ด หนา 4 มม ทาสี' -- 4 mm painted fibre-cement board closing the gable/soffit under the main roof. It is the same board the A-01 list uses for ceilings 3 and 4.
The cornice (100 x 100 mm) and the scored groove (10 x 10 mm) appear again, once each.
The bottom chain totals 11.00 m between grids D and A, with 0.40 outside D and 1.60 outside A -- the same figures as the letter-direction chain on the floor plans.
